# What Loom sees

Loom reads your source without booting the app and records what it finds, one index section per primitive.

<!-- generated:output:scan -->

<!-- /generated:output:scan -->

The sections and their fields are in the [schema](../reference/schema.md#top-level-fields). The code shapes each scanner reads, and the ones it skips, are tested examples under [What Loom detects](../reference/detection/index.md).

## Why a static index

One event is wired in several files: dispatched in a controller, handled by a listener linked only by the type hint on `handle()`, and by a closure a provider registers. Grep finds the dispatch and the closure, not the listener. Loom follows each link and stores it in [one index](the-index.md), so it reports what your code says, not what one request did.

## What Loom can't see

A class picked at runtime has no name in the source. Loom lists each such call in `unresolved_dispatches` or `unresolved_routes` with its file, line and a `reason` instead of dropping it. The [reason table](../reference/detection/index.md#unresolved-reasons) leads from a `reason` to the code that produces it, and `loom:check` can [fail on new ones](../recipes/new-unresolved-dispatches.md).

If something you expected is missing, start at [Why was my code missed?](../guides/why-was-my-code-missed.md)
